name: Kill Confirmed
summary: Once per short rest, when you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack, turn the hit into a critical hit. If the target is already bloodied, Suppressed, prone, or exposed out of cover, add an extra 2d6 damage after resolving the critical hit.
